correctness.rationale: Use tetrahedron tight-frame identities Σt_i=0, Σt_i²=4/3 to parametrize directions. For x=rho/R>0 with nonzero squared distance factors, constrained log-product extrema have at most two distinct t_i; three possibilities give squared product A=(x-1)²(1+x²+2x/3)³, B=(x+1)²(1+x²-2x/3)³ and C=(1+2x²/3+x⁴)². Exact independent symbolic factorizations A-C=-64x³(x²+x+1)/27, B-C=64x³(x²-x+1)/27, A-B=-128x³(x²+1)/27 establish A<C<B. x=1 zeros and x=0 center handled; continuity fills interval. Sampled random directions over eight positive radii with no violation; analytical proof is the basis.
